accounting: M is per selected N7. Issue draws and stake are selected_identity_count×M and selected_identity_count×M×¥2. K/M are frozen outputs rather than rejection gates. Frozen no-bets are retained separately from unavailable canonical outcomes. ticket_tax_ledger.csv.gz records each winning portfolio/draw multiplicity with its individual ticket gross and per-ticket tax; ticket_tax_reconciliation.csv proves its total exactly matches the issue ledger.

decision.rule: Promotion requires positive matched no-tax and actual-tax deltas across all three frozen seeds and every YEAR/FOLD/LOYO view. A one-seed, sparse-M, raw-ROI or tax-only maximum is not promotable.

input_boundary: Only accepted Gate-A v2 and canonical final-SP settlement input are read. Gate-A v3/post-acceptance material is not read.
metrics: surface_summary.csv.gz contains ALL/YEAR/FOLD/LOYO; issue_policy_settlement is the issue-level ledger. Selector lift uses same-gate K_ALL FULL; sampler lift uses exact selected-K FULL; interaction uses K_ALL FULL. Overlap, duplicate/unique ticket coverage, concentration, drawdown, miss streak and largest-event sensitivity are retained.
sampling_replay: The accepted Gate-A hash-based samplers are replayed exactly. Each ordered selected_match_ids tuple is its sampler key; duplicate draws retain stake, while WOR/top/delete arms are distinct-ticket mechanisms.
scope: historical paper research only; no purchase, production, or promotion authority.
settlement: Each selected ticket pays ¥2×0.65×product(canonical final winning SP) per hit. The ticket itself is the only tax unit: 20% applies only where that one ticket's gross is at least ¥10,000. No issue, N7 identity, sampler draw, M replicate, strategy arm or ticket count is pooled to determine the threshold. A duplicate WR hit is represented as an independent ticket count at the same per-ticket gross.
